```python
import re

def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
    pattern = r"^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    return bool(re.match(pattern, email))
```

Checks for a name part, an `@`, a domain, and a dot-suffix like `.com`. It won't catch every edge case — for real signup forms, sending a confirmation link still beats regex.
